title: Autocalibration Sentinel: Canary rollout and automatic rollback for compressed models
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an automated "autocalibration sentinel" that runs calibration + accuracy validation for FP8/INT8 profiles, gates canary rollouts using statistical checks, and executes an automatic fallback to higher-precision variants when quality regressions are detected. This work scopes the calibration harness integration with the canary controller, defines quantitative thresholds, implements rollback orchestration, and wires observability + alerting for incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness can produce per-model precision profiles (FP8, INT8) and a validation report with metric deltas within the pipeline run
Canary controller accepts a candidate quantized model and enacts staged traffic slices (1% -> 5% -> 25%) while collecting evaluation metrics and distribution statistics
Automated rollback triggers when one or more validation checks fail for a configured lookback window; rollback must complete within 30s under normal conditions
Fallback path to the pinned high-precision model (FP32/bfloat16) is exercised automatically with traffic steering and no client-visible errors
Post-rollback notifications are sent to oncall Slack channel, an incident record is created, and audit logs capture the canary decision and metrics snapshot
Manual 'force-accept' override requires a two-person approval and is recorded in the audit log
technical_notes: Calibration pipeline: sample stratified set from replay store by customer cohort + latency tier; compute activation histograms and per-layer scale/zero-point candidates

Validation harness performs simulated inference on the replayed requests (not synthetic prompts) and computes task-level metrics (generation diffs, token-level perplexity delta, top-k token shift stats)
Statistical gating: use paired bootstrap + 95% confidence interval on metric delta; require upper bound of relative quality loss < 1% OR absolute metric thresholds (task-specific) to proceed
Canary progression steps: traffic fractions [0.01, 0.05, 0.25]; each step requires N requests or T time window (min 10k tokens or 5 minutes) and stable metrics before next step
Drift detection: KL divergence on softmax logits and median token-rank changes; if drift > configured threshold, mark canary unstable and trigger rollback
Runtime integration: quantized kernels must expose compatibility flags for KV cache and token streaming; fallback must be kernel-switchable without client reconnects
Rollback orchestration: controller calls routing-service API to reassign weights to fallback pool, verifies steady-state latency and error-rate before draining canary replicas
Observability: dashboard widgets for quality delta, CI widths, per-layer outlier counts, latency P50/P95, and rollback events; retention of full canary snapshots for 30 days
Security: calibration artifacts and evaluation data must be stored in encrypted buckets with KMS keys; access audited per RBAC rules
Performance guardrails: if quantized candidate reduces throughput or increases p95 latency by > 10% relative to baseline, fail gating
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Dry run (dev): run calibration and validation in staging with replayed traffic; no traffic steering; validate metrics pipeline
Phase 1 - Internal canary: deploy to internal tenant only (1% internal traffic) for 24h; verify automated checks and Slack alerts
Phase 2 - Customer canary: staged traffic slices 1% -> 5% -> 25% across low-risk cohorts; enable automatic rollback and observe for 72h
Phase 3 - Ramp: after stable canary for 72h across cohorts and no breaches, allow rollout to 50% then 100% with monitoring
Rollback behavior: immediate steering to fallback pool on trigger; automated retry of calibration pipeline for next candidate; create issue with calibration report attached
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration metric collectors and hypothesis test codepath
Integration tests: full pipeline from calibration -> canary controller -> routing-service -> fallback, using synthetic replay generator
Load test: ensure rollback completes under 1k req/s and under heavy KV cache pressure; measure 95th percentile failover time
A/B regression tests: compare production baseline vs quantized candidate on heldout customer prompts for at least 48h
Chaos test: simulate partial network partition of quantized pool during canary and verify safe rollback and no client timeouts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Calibration sample bias leading to unseen customer prompts failing in production. Mitigation: stratified sampling, holdout cohorts, and mandatory replay of recent N days of traffic
Risk: False-positive rollback from noisy metrics. Mitigation: require multiple independent signals (quality + distribution + latency) and use conservative CI thresholds
Risk: Rollback latency causing transient errors. Mitigation: pre-provision warm fallback capacity and test steering path in staging
Risk: Confidentiality of evaluation prompts. Mitigation: evaluation runs on customer-controlled ephemeral nodes for private deployments and encryption at rest
notifications_and_runbook: Automated Slack message template should include: candidate id, model family, quant profile (FP8/INT8), canary fraction, metric deltas, CI bounds, and rollback reason
Runbook steps: 1) Inspect canary dashboard, 2) Validate top 3 failed metrics, 3) If rollback triggered, confirm fallback pool health, 4) Open postmortem if customer impact > medium
Escalation: if rollback re-triggers twice within 24h, page SRE lead and product manager
